questions.subject: SPANISH
questions.learningObjective: Choose ser or estar for a permanent trait
questions.stem: In an engineer's design brief, a steel beam is described as strong and durable for the bridge.

options.text: El acero es fuerte y duradero para el puente.
El acero esta fuerte y duradero para el puente.
options.misconception: uses estar for an inherent material property

options.text: El acero es fuerte y duradero para el puente.
options.misconception: confuses permanent trait with temporary state

options.text: El acero esta fuerte y duradero para el puente.
options.misconception: treats a lasting quality as a passing condition

questions.explanation: Ser marks inherent, permanent characteristics such as material strength, while estar marks temporary states. The beam's strength is an intrinsic property of steel.
questions.hint: Ask whether the quality is permanent or temporary.
